node.statement: If v is bijective, then the map v_tilde furnished above is injective: for every x in B, the level-one lower norm bound for the extended delta-inclusion v and the displacement estimate give ||v_tilde(x)|| >= ||v(x)||-||(v_tilde-v)(x)|| >= (1-delta-|K_disp|*delta)||x|| >= (1/2)||x||.
